documents.preset_yaml:
id: standard
major: 1
renamed:
  studio.old: sender.studio
rules:
  - id: guard.login
    category: money
    stage: guard
    retain: true
    when: [{kind: subject_contains, value: 'login code'}]
  - id: sender.studio
    category: orders
    stage: from
    when: [{kind: from_domain, value: studio.example.com}]
  - id: topic.money
    category: money
    stage: subject
    when: [{kind: subject_contains, value: invoice}]
  - id: topic.money.de
    category: money
    stage: subject
    when: [{kind: subject_contains, value: Rechnung}]
  - id: topic.contracts
    category: contracts
    stage: subject
    when: [{kind: subject_contains, value: contract}]
  - id: topic.orders
    category: orders
    stage: subject
    when: [{kind: subject_contains, value: order}]
  - id: topic.travel
    category: travel
    stage: subject
    when: [{kind: subject_contains, value: booking}]
  - id: topic.social
    category: social
    stage: from
    when: [{kind: from_domain, value: social.example.net}]
documents.override_yaml:
preset: standard
major: 1
roles:
  domains:
    work.example.test: business
    home.example.test: personal
    signup.example.test: personal
  addresses:
    unknown@work.example.test: unknown
  signup_domains: [signup.example.test]
patches:
  - id: studio.old
    folder: Studio
additions:
  - id: user.release
    category: orders
    stage: subject
    when: [{kind: subject_contains, value: release}]
    folder: Releases
ledger:
  - address: invoices@work.example.test
    status: active
    category: money
    invoice: true
    folder: Invoices
  - address: retired@signup.example.test
    status: retired
    category: orders
    invoice: false
    folder: null
targets:
  accounting: {address: archive@example.net}
forwards:
  - id: forward.approved
    target: accounting
    trigger:
      kind: approved_senders
      addresses: [billing@shop.example.org]
  - id: forward.invoice_address
    target: accounting
    trigger: {kind: invoice_address}
  - id: forward.keywords
    target: accounting
    trigger: {kind: keywords, words: [invoice, Rechnung]}
